newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all slip amid easier crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all slip amid easier crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Friday, hit by falling crude, traders said.
Gasoline was weaker. Barges traded between $201 and $202 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil was weaker. Cargoes for March lifting traded at $92 cif NWE.
Gas oil fell by up to $3 a tonne reflecting futures' weakness although some premiums firmed slightly.
Naphtha fell, pressured lower by weaker crude and good supplies resulting from good crude/naphtha cracks.
